install.playDescription: Signing in with Google needs the <companionLink>Open Grind Google OAuth app</companionLink>.
install.description: Download and install the <companionLink>Open Grind Google OAuth app</companionLink> to sign in with Google.

continue.description: Continue in the <companionLink>Open Grind Google OAuth app</companionLink> to sign in with Google.

steps.install: Install the <companionLink>Open Grind Google OAuth app</companionLink>.
steps.copyToken: Sign in with Google in the Open Grind Google OAuth app and copy the token.
steps.submit: Return to this screen, paste the token, and tap “{{button}}”.

errors.untrusted: The installed Open Grind Google OAuth app isn’t signed by Open Grind, so its token was refused. Uninstall it, or paste the OAuth token manually.
errors.refused: The Open Grind Google OAuth app only accepts official copies of Open Grind. Update it, or paste the OAuth token manually.
errors.disabled: The Open Grind Google OAuth app is turned off. Turn it on in Android settings, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Couldn’t find the Open Grind Google OAuth app on your device. Install it first, or paste the OAuth token manually.

errors.unsupportedPlatform: This account needs reCAPTCHA verification, which works only on Android with the Open Grind reCAPTCHA helper.
errors.addonUnavailable: Install the Open Grind reCAPTCHA helper to sign in to this account.
errors.addonDisabled: The Open Grind reCAPTCHA helper is turned off. Turn it on in Android settings, then try again.
errors.addonUntrusted: The installed Open Grind reCAPTCHA helper isn’t an official build.
errors.grindrMissing: The Open Grind reCAPTCHA helper needs the official Grindr app installed to verify this sign-in.
errors.verifyFailed: Couldn’t complete reCAPTCHA verification. Try again.

errors.dialogError: Facebook didn’t grant access. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.
errors.handoffRefused: Facebook tried to open its own app, which Open Grind can’t use. Sign in with your email and password instead.

errors.notRegistered: This account isn’t registered with Grindr. Sign up in the official Grindr app first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
